title: Were OpenAI's monitoring flaws independently re-tested after the reported fixes?
summary: METR and Redwood evaluated an earlier internal system. OpenAI reported patches; METR explicitly said it had not tested those later claims.
scope: The July–August exercise assessed historical controls, not the present production environment.
next: A new independent test of the patched safeguards with a disclosed scope and methodology.
events: METR and Redwood performed a high-access monitoring red-team pilot.
METR said it had not evaluated OpenAI's reported subsequent fixes.
